name: Tech.eu

requirements: European tech/startup ecosystem focus — funding rounds, acquisitions, expansion, product news
'Pitch Your Startup' form at tech.eu/startup-form (nav: Tech.eu > Pitch Your Startup)

Earned editorial — staff-written coverage of European tech; no listing product

preparation: A European angle — HQ, funding round, or market significance in Europe
Concise pitch for the startup form: what it is, traction, why now
workflow: For event visibility, apply to pitch at the Tech.eu Summit startup stage (free tickets for early-stage companies)
Coverage, if picked up, is a staff-written news/funding article
Advertising is a separate nav item
watchFor: Europe-first remit — non-European startups are off-beat
The startup-form page fetch returned 404 even though the nav link is present — verify in a real browser; the Contact page is the fallback
Much coverage is funding-driven — unfunded launches compete poorly
